pre_build: emcc -O1 -DNDEBUG -Isrc/dsp -sNODERAWFS=1 src/dsp/rex_encode_main.c src/dsp/dwop_encode.c src/dsp/dwop.c src/dsp/wav_reader.c src/dsp/rex_writer.c src/dsp/rex_parser.c -o .wasm-demo/rex-encode.js
demo_content: loops/schwung-wasm-demo-loop.rx2: modules/demo/gen_demo_samples.py loop (original, CC0-1.0) encoded at build time with the repo's own rex-encode (compiled with emcc, run under node)
wasm_notes: The release also ships rex-encode, an aarch64 CLI used by the UI to convert WAVs on-device; it is not part of the wasm module (no exec in the browser).
